Eden (People Ops): All-hands Tuesday 9:00am PT — short agenda + Qs in replies by Monday EOD. Recording will be posted.

Harper (CEO): Quick opener: two focus areas for the quarter and one hiring note.

Nico (Product): I'll demo the Dedicated autopilot canary (8m). tagging @Riley for infra callouts.

Riley (Eng): I'll cover the batching default change and the cleanup of debug-log retention defaults for Dedicated. TL;DR: default now 30 days; Dedicated can request extensions.

Samir (Platform): I'll show a brief p95 chart (KV cache improvements) and a note on quantization experiments.

Eden (People Ops): Draft agenda: 9:00 intro (Harper), 9:06 Product demo (Nico), 9:14 Eng callouts (Riley), 9:20 Platform metrics (Samir), 9:25 Q&A, 9:40 Close + takeaways.

Nico (Product): Can infra/plat be on Q&A? @Riley @Samir

Riley (Eng): yes. quick pasteable for Q&A:
```
redwoodctl config set batching.max_batch 50
redwoodctl deploy inference
```
notes-bot: Calendar invite -> https://calendar.example.com/event/4992004321 (Zoom in invite). Reminder scheduled.

(After meeting) notes-bot: Recording + slides posted -> https://videos.example.com/recordings/4992004321 and https://drive.example.com/4992004321-slides.pdf

Eden (People Ops): Post-meeting TL;DR: Autopilot canary next week, retention default shortened to 30 days (Dedicated exceptions via support), dark-mode opt-in pilot, p95 improved ~16%. Follow-ups and owners in the shared doc.

Harper (CEO): Thanks all. Great cross-team work.
